asA: operator upgrading a product from rcf-lite 0.36.x to 0.37.0
iWant: the release to tell my agents to refresh the managed block, and the docs to describe the new Finalise and Verify
soThat: the upgrade lands in every consumer and nobody runs a retired command from the docs
description: The release feed and the docs (D-15).
title: An operator upgrading a downstream product is told to rerun init and finds the docs on the 0.37.0 model

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given packages/rcf-lite/releases/releases.yaml at the release head, when its top entry is read, then its version equals packages/rcf-lite/package.json's version (0.37.0), breaking is true and minAgentAction is rerun-init, and node scripts/validate-releases.mjs exits 0.

[happy] Given packages/rcf-lite/docs/verify-reference.md at this slice's reviewed head or any later head, then its finalise synopsis reads "rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref>", its modes section names release mode (--release, --since, --record) and calls the catalog and agent modes optional probes that are never a precondition, and the forward catalog contract no longer says the deterministic engine feeds Finalise.

[failure] Given any file under packages/rcf-lite/docs/, packages/rcf-lite/README.md or the root README.md at this slice's reviewed head or any later head, a search for "rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --url", "--mode <mode>" in a finalise synopsis, or a sentence saying a spec is verified at Finalise or by the Test stage finds nothing; any such line fails this criterion.

[must-not] The READMEs never describe verification of a deployed app as part of the build cycle: the root README.md and packages/rcf-lite/README.md each state that the build cycle ends at complete and that a release Verify writes verified, and neither tells a reader to wait for verified before the next Build.
